summary: IDS feed s072_single is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10, 20 are completely missing, breaking VLAN-aware detection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream TAP/SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags before delivery - 100% of packets arrived untagged so VLANs 10 and 20 are invisible. Most likely broker egress port configured to strip tags or VLAN filter misconfigured to drop tagged traffic.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation-aware policies and correlation. Without tags it cannot attribute traffic to correct VLAN/tenant, causing missed detections for lateral movement and VLAN-hopping and incomplete coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the packet broker to the IDS tool port so the IDS can see required segmentation context.
